# Module `pill_core::profiling::profiling_extras`

Source: `engine\pill_core\src\profiling.rs:528`

Helpers that need the full `profiling` feature: plots, messages and thread
names.

## Module contents

### Functions
- [`error`](fn.error.md#rustdoc-item-1367) — Emits an error message, shown in red (RGBA 0xFF0000FF).
- [`message`](fn.message.md#rustdoc-item-1365) — Emits a diagnostic message, shown in white.
- [`plot`](fn.plot.md#rustdoc-item-1362) — Adds one value to a named time-series plot.
- [`plot_config`](fn.plot_config.md#rustdoc-item-1363) — Configures how a plot appears in the Tracy profiler UI.
- [`set_thread_name`](fn.set_thread_name.md#rustdoc-item-1368) — Sets the display name of the current thread in Tracy.
- [`warn`](fn.warn.md#rustdoc-item-1366) — Emits a warning message, shown in orange (RGBA 0xFF8800FF).
